pending_questions.text: Should the booking reject past dates, or should I leave date-range restrictions unspecified because the requirements do not state one?
pending_questions.rationale: R4 says only that the visitor chooses a visit date with a control stating its expected format (L14-L15); it gives no permitted date range or behavior for past dates.

options.label: Leave unspecified
options.detail: Extract only the stated date-selection and visible-format promises; do not assume a past-date rule.

options.label: Reject past dates
options.detail: Treat rejection of dates before today as an owner-supplied requirement for this booking goal.
